newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge lower following U.S. markets.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge lower following U.S. markets.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged lower in early Tuesday morning trade, depressed by feeble U.S. markets overnight, brokers said. They added that market sentiment was gloomy, after the bank sector came under fierce selling pressure the previous day.
As of 0017 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 105.11 points or 0.61 percent at 17,229.79. Its March futures had shed 140 points to stand at 17,240.
"Market participants are eyeing the 17,000 line," said Ken Ishikida, Sanyo Securities general manager. "Bargain hunting could appear to prevent it from falling past that point."
